title: The bicycle
logline: A girl's bicycle against the seawall, close: a basket, a zine in the basket, a sticker on the frame with an eye on it. The town's other story in one object. The page doesn't touch it.

panels.composition: A bicycle leaning against a seawall, close: a wire basket with a stapled zine in it, a small eye sticker on the frame, the bay beyond.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bicycle leaning against a seawall seen close with a wire basket holding a stapled zine and a small eye sticker on the frame, a bay beyond, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
